about_the_game:
A beautifully dark soundtrack for horror fans

This DLC contains the full original soundtrack of the psychological horror game Shadowless. It contains ambient instrumental music ranging from soft melodies to darkly themed and disturbing music. It features a blend of piano, violin, guitar, and electronic drones to create a truly immersive ambiance that takes the listener to a beautifully melancholic mood.
